name: Tidal Music
author: jaj
description: Native Tidal music player for Omarchy featuring Hi-Res Lossless FLAC playback via PipeWire, bar widget and now-playing flyout, full catalog search, favorites and playlists, Google Cast audio streaming, and MPRIS2 desktop controls.

barWidget.description: Now-playing bar widget, player controls, and Tidal library search
